content_probe: One native low-state and one native full TRAIN call per seed; one fixed decoded reward preparation and two expected raw-utility values; shared across the two diagnostic methods, never reused as a free qualified-build cache

cost_boundary.actual_cpu: Internal timer begins before dependency imports and includes child CPU until before final receipt serialization; root external launcher retains complete worker/startup/final serialization and parent overhead
cost_boundary.attribution: Single R&D diagnostic total; shared probe/normalizer costs are explicitly visible. No claim that cumulative research budgets were matched
cost_boundary.declared: Actual content/decoder/value kernels, every OOF normalizer/ridge/prediction, target/decision and metric/group-sort inventories charged to one bounded WorkLedger; no unused probability-feature kernels
cost_boundary.native_reuse: Existing T11 native library is reused by exact SHA; no compiler invocation. Historical compilation/build costs are not erased or credited to a qualified build
cost_boundary.unpriced_as_operators: data-generation RNG, allocation/copies, hashing, I/O and serialization remain in actual CPU/wall; mathematical inventories are not hardware FLOPs/energy

limitations: Critic OOF only: fixed content encoders saw all TRAIN physical sources
The fixed T11 checkpoints were previously selected using validation; no new validation statistics are used for this diagnostic or method selection
No held-out or content-generalization estimate; r2 formal split remains sealed
Classification scores cannot silently replace raw-gain units or the production CPU-price law
No production head/model/plan/threshold changes and no qualification claim; promising evidence can only motivate a separately reviewed, costed candidate

metrics.concentration: top1 and top5 physical-source shares of false-stop lost net and raw utility; all sources retained; no outlier removal
metrics.primary: physical-source-equal mean abs(delta-TRAIN_price)*1[action differs from delta>TRAIN_price]

mse42.objective: ordinary unweighted raw-gain MSE plus .001 ridge; unpenalized intercept
mse42.prediction: clip to fit-fold raw-gain support; continue when prediction > fixed per-seed TRAIN decision_price

new_evidence_and_nonrepeat.excluded_repeats: No 31-vs-42 representation comparison, no third classifier, no lambda/threshold/feature search, no content-model training or comparison of historical best results
new_evidence_and_nonrepeat.new_fixed_state: T11 three selected NC checkpoints each have 488 updates at fixed LR .01 and their existing TRAIN-derived decision prices; these bytes and prices differ from the earlier T5 probe
new_evidence_and_nonrepeat.new_question: Within the already adopted 42-dimensional hidden/instruction representation, does unweighted raw-gain MSE make a small number of large-regret stopping decisions, and does the fixed regret-weighted binary objective change those decisions?
new_evidence_and_nonrepeat.prior_t5_weighted_classifier: 31 probability-derived p/q features; it always continued; retained without reinterpretation

one_shot: Directory must contain only this protocol before execute; exclusive START precedes TRAIN construction; completed or failed receipt prevents any repeat; never invoke evaluation or dataset(test)
source_folds: Within each of 12 TRAIN source classes, SHA(salt+NUL+source_id) order cycles across four folds; all instructions/variants of one physical source stay together; expected 48 physical sources and 768 rows per hold fold

weighted_binary42.label: y = 1[actual full-minus-low decoded raw utility > fixed per-seed TRAIN decision_price]
weighted_binary42.normalizer: same fit-fold-only unweighted population mean/std and .05 scale floor; weighted centering removes the unpenalized intercept
weighted_binary42.prediction: dimensionless score clipped to [0,1], continue at fixed score > .5; not a raw-gain estimate
weighted_binary42.weight: abs(actual full-minus-low decoded raw utility - fixed per-seed TRAIN decision_price); fit rows only; zero total weight fails explicitly
